name: hardstock
description: Machine-readable token source of truth for the Hardstock design language. Every generated surface must reference these by name; never hardcode a hex value in a component.

media.screen: All tokens apply as written. Absolute values are CSS pixels.
media.print: Color roles, type roles and the proportional system carry over unchanged. Absolute pixel values do not: re-derive them from `print.derivation` below. The `motion` and `breakpoint` groups do not exist in print. See references/print.md.

ink.role: The single dark. Text, EVERY border, EVERY shadow, focus ring, scrollbar thumb, underlines.
ink.note: Warm near-black, not #000. One ink governs the whole system.

canvas.role: Page background. Warm cream paper stock.

raised.role: Primary card / panel fill on canvas

muted.role: Secondary text and placeholders only. Never body copy, never on a colored fill.

accent.role: The one lead accent. Primary buttons, hero highlight marks, active navigation.
accent.constraint: Exactly one accent per page. It is brand, not semantics.

onFill.role: Text color on ANY colored fill, in every theme including dark.
onFill.constraint: Never grey text on a colored block.

mono.use: Badges, timestamps, status, eyebrows, labels, channel prefixes, tabular data

body.use: Paragraph copy. Deliberately generic so the display/mono pair carries the character.

radius.constraint: Zero everywhere. No exceptions, including avatars, toggles, radios, pills and modals.

border.note: 2px is the workhorse. Every interactive or grouped element gets one.

shadow.constraint: Blur radius is always 0. Depth comes from displacement, not softness.

icon.forbidden: emoji (round, multicolor, breaks the ink system)

print.note: Do not convert the pixel values. Re-derive every measurement from body size using these ratios, which are what actually define the language. Full guidance in references/print.md.

microLabel.extra: add 0.05 to 0.1em tracking, more than the screen value

minimumRuleWeight.rule: If the derived weight falls under the floor for your process, raise the rule rather than preserve the ratio.

ink.canvasIsPaper: The canvas token is a paper choice, not a flood tint. Pick a warm uncoated stock.
ink.hairlinesAndSmallText: K-only, set to overprint. Four-color hairlines misregister and fringe, and this language is built from hairlines.
ink.largeSolids: Rich black, near C40 M30 Y30 K100, confirmed with the printer. Never place small text or a hairline on top of it.
ink.accent: One accent per page turns into a two-color job: black plus one spot. Cheaper than CMYK and fully saturated.
ink.gamutWarning: Saturated cyan, lime and pink sit outside the coated CMYK gamut and print duller. Proof against the printer's profile, or run a spot.

trim.ruleClearance: Rules sit at least 5mm inside the trim, or run fully off the bleed. Never 1 to 4mm from the edge: trim tolerance is about 1mm and the eye measures that gap against the rule.
